preconditions.expression: len(lines) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in lines)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n lines, each of length m, representing the map grid.
The dimensions n and m are within the specified bounds, and the grid has at least 2 cells.
The maximum number of distinct plot types allowed in a path is between 1 and 4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(1 for row in lines for c in row if c == 'S') == 1 and sum(1 for row in lines for c in row if c == 'T') == 1
preconditions.description: The map contains exactly one starting square 'S' and exactly one terminating square 'T'.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c in 'ST' for row in lines for c in row)
preconditions.description: Every cell in the map contains either a lowercase Latin letter, 'S', or 'T'.

postconditions.expression: output == '-1' or (len(output) == min_path_length and output == min_lex_path)
postconditions.description: If a valid path exists, the output is the lexicographically smallest sequence of plot types among all shortest valid paths; otherwise, it is '-1'.

postconditions.expression: output != '-1' implies (len(set(output)) <= k and all(c.islower() for c in output))
postconditions.description: If a path is found, the sequence of characters contains only lowercase letters and the number of distinct characters is at most k.
If a path is found, its length (number of steps) is the minimum possible among all valid paths from S to T.

postconditions.expression: output != '-1' implies (output == min([p for p in all_valid_path_sequences if len(p) == shortest_valid_path_length]))
postconditions.description: Among all valid paths with the minimum length, the output sequence is the lexicographically smallest one.
